model: Qwen3.8-27B W4A16, packed INT4 KV, MTP4, prefix caching, max_num_seqs=1
caveats: API sweeps are single samples, not statistical interleaved A/B trials; first-shape 4k TTFT is warmup-sensitive.
The 128k API baseline is windowed W4A16, not the original full-staging runtime.
Combined serving changes both precision and batch limit; their end-to-end contributions are not isolated.
Synthetic-prose decode rates depend on MTP/lookup acceptance and are not representative of general coding.
Window microbenchmarks precede final harness packaging; workspace_bytes excludes the optional extend scratch.
GEMM microbenchmarks measure repack plus GEMM; they are not model throughput.
PPL used a 65536-token, 3 GiB KV profile for logits headroom, not the full serving profile.
